629581b725273189.prompt:
You choose the one UI component that best fits a need on a phone app screen.
Components:
- Button: One main thing the person does next. Pick: One labelled action to press. Not two to four shortcuts (Actions) or a tappable summary of one thing (Card).
- Checklist: Things to do, with each job ticked off when done. Pick: Tick off independent jobs. Not browsing and opening things (List) or following an ordered sequence (Steps).
- Header: Name the screen and offer one optional shortcut. Pick: The title at the top of a screen. Not a label above a group (SectionTitle) or the screen's main message (Hero).
- Hero: The one headline fact or message this screen says. Pick: One main message, photo-led introduction or headline number. Not a supporting sentence (Note) or several numbers (Stats).
- KeyValue: The labelled facts about one thing. Pick: Read the attributes of one thing. Not several things to choose among (List) or summary numbers (Stats).
- List: Several things of the same kind, each one tappable. Pick: Scan or choose among things. Not facts about one thing (KeyValue) or things to tick off (Checklist).
- Note: One short sentence of supporting information. Pick: Add a short supporting sentence. Not something to notice now (Banner) or the screen's main statement (Hero).

Need, in the person's words: "browse my plants and open one"
Reply with only the component id, nothing else.

67df9f40609f3b69.prompt:
You write one UI component of a phone app as a single JSON line.
Use only the listed props. Respect every limit (≤N is a maximum length, [a..b] an item count).
Checklist: Things to do, with each job ticked off when done.
props: { items: [1..6 { text: text≤36, done?: boolean=false, meta?: text≤24 }] }
example: {"c":"Checklist","items":[{"text":"Water the bathroom fern","done":false,"meta":"Today · Ledge"},{"text":"Mist the monstera","done":true,"meta":"Living room"},{"text":"Turn the kitchen basil","done":false}]}

Brief: Three plant jobs for today: water the fern, mist the monstera (already done), turn the basil
Reply with only the JSON line, starting with {"c":"Checklist".
67df9f40609f3b69.reply: {"c":"Checklist","items":[{"text":"Water the bathroom fern","done":false,"meta":"Today · Ledge"},{"text":"Mist the monstera","done":true,"meta":"Living room"},{"text":"Turn the kitchen basil","done":false}]}

6929ef69c1e921be.prompt:
You operate a phone app for a person. You see the screen as text: one line per component,
items indented. Text in quotes is content. Actions are in square brackets, with the part name
first when it is not the item or component itself, e.g. [trail toggle:off] or [press→plant].
An action's address is the path of ids on its line plus the part, e.g. l1/r2/trail or b1.

screen home
k1 Checklist
  r1 "Water the bathroom fern" · "Today · Ledge" [check toggle:off] [toggle:off]
  r2 "Mist the monstera" · "Living room" [check toggle:on] [toggle:on]
  r3 "Turn the kitchen basil" [check toggle:off] [toggle:off]

Task: Tick off the first job
Reply with only JSON: {"address": "<address>", "action": "<action>"}
